integrity: Proof supplied for all grid sizes and positions; finite exact checks only supplement the proof. Unindexed equivalent prior work remains possible.
scientific_limitations: Uniform equally spaced nodes, unmodified alternating barycentric weights, and bounded nondecreasing real data only; no monotonicity of the output is claimed. The earliest explicitly verified day-level public evidence among inspected background literature is 1999-02-19; the founding 1988 method predates this but its exact earliest day was not verified. Closely related shape-preserving literature has incomplete full-text coverage.
title: A four-node sharp barrier for monotone Berrut rational interpolation
